app_fee.value: The Graduate Research Admissions Policy states the university may charge an application fee, but specifies no fee amount for research degree applications.
app_fee.quote: (17) The University may charge an application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No fee amount is specified for research applications, and no fee waiver provision is stated.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated in Macquarie University graduate research admission policies.

toefl_min.value: Schedule 1 sets TOEFL iBT minimum score of 86 overall (18 reading, 21 writing, 17 listening, 21 speaking) for most Graduate Research courses.
toefl_min.quote: Competent English 86 18 21 17 21 Most Graduate Research courses

ielts_min.value: Schedule 1 sets IELTS Academic minimum score of 6.5 overall (minimum 6.0 in all bands) for most Graduate Research courses.
ielts_min.quote: Competent English 6.5 6.0 6.0 6.0 6.0 Most Graduate Research courses

english_waiver.value: Macquarie accepts prior study in specified English-speaking countries (Australia, Canada, New Zealand, South Africa, Ireland, UK, USA) or postgraduate study taught in English from 13 listed countries (not including India).
english_waiver.quote:
Section 2: Study undertaken in specified English-speaking countries

notes: Macquarie University admits doctoral candidates under the centralized Graduate Research Admissions Policy. Minimum degree requirements and English language standards are governed centrally by the Graduate Research Academy and Academic Senate.
